title: Completeness of low-degree squarefree polynomials on the root cube
statement: Let $K$ be a field and let $\omega \in K$ satisfy $\omega \ne 1$. For natural numbers $n$ and $D$, write $\{1,\omega\}^n$ for the set of vectors $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to K$ each of whose coordinates equals $1$ or $\omega$, and let $\mathcal{S}_{n,D}$ be the collection of finsets $s \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n$ with $\abs{s} \le D$. Then for every polynomial $Q \in K[X_i : i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,n]$ of total degree at most $D$, there exist coefficients $c : \mathcal{S}_{n,D} \to K$ such that the squarefree polynomial $\sum_{\abs{s} \le D} c(s)\,\prod_{i \in s} X_i$ agrees with $Q$ at every point of $\{1,\omega\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: Q is a multivariate polynomial in n variables over the field K
total degree of Q is at most D
conclusion: existence of coefficients c on low-degree supports whose squarefree polynomial equals Q on the whole root cube {1,ω}^n
replaced:
Assume $\omega \ne 1$.  Every polynomial $Q$ with $\deg Q \le D$ agrees on the root cube
$\{1,\omega\}^n$ with a low-degree squarefree polynomial: there are coefficients $c$ on
$\texttt{ACP.LowDegreeSupport}\ n\ D$ such that
$(\texttt{ACP.lowDegreeSquarefreePolynomial}\ c)(x) = Q(x)$ for all $x$ in the cube.
